item.title: GenderCARE: A Comprehensive Framework for Assessing and Reducing Gender Bias in Large Language Models
item.description: GenderCARE contributes practical criteria, benchmarks, and reduction techniques for measuring and mitigating gender bias in LLMs while preserving general task performance.

item.title: Digger: Detecting Copyright Content Mis-usage in Large Language Model Training
item.description: Digger introduces methods for detecting whether copyrighted content has been used to train Large Language Models, providing tools for addressing legal and ethical concerns in AI development.
